characters.name: Den yngste kongssønnen som sjømann
characters.description: Den yngste kongssønnen i forkledning, med en stor sjømannsjakke og et rødt tørkle rundt hodet. Først later han som han er en stakkars sjømann, og så en kremmer.
characters.look: A slim young man of about eighteen disguised as a poor sailor, with a kind face, a straight nose, steady green-grey eyes and a few days' dark stubble. His wavy dark-brown hair is tucked under a red kerchief knotted around his head. He wears a huge, baggy, dark-blue knitted sailor's jacket with wooden buttons that hangs down to his knees, patched canvas trousers and scuffed, salt-stained boots.

characters.name: Den yngste prinsessen
characters.description: Den yngste av de tolv, stille men modig, som beskytter seg selv og til slutt tør å si sannheten.
characters.look: A small, slender princess of about seventeen with a round, solemn face, a short nose, dark-blue eyes under thick, level brows and a small, determined mouth. Her honey-brown hair is braided into a crown around her head. She wears a long cream-coloured dress with gold embroidery on the bodice and hem, long fitted sleeves and a narrow gold belt, with a tiny silver brooch shaped like an anchor at her throat.

characters.name: Fugl Dam
characters.description: En enorm, hjelpsom fugl som hjelper kongssønnen når han blir forlatt, og flyr ham trygt dit han trenger å være.
characters.look: An enormous, friendly bird as tall as a three-storey house, so big that a man reaches only to its ankle, shaped a little like a giant gull. characters.name: Ridder Rød
characters.description: Styrmannen som blir misunnelig og prøver å ta æren, men som til slutt mister makten når sannheten kommer fram.
characters.look: A tall, barrel-chested, vain knight of about forty with a big square jaw, a cleft chin, a short straight nose held high, small, cold pale-blue eyes and a proud smirk. He has short flame-red hair and a short, pointed flame-red beard. He wears a round, polished steel helmet with a stiff red crest, a long scarlet surcoat with a gold border over a shirt of shiny chainmail, a wide black belt with a big gold buckle and tall black boots.

characters.name: Trollkongen med tolv hoder
characters.description: En trollkonge med tolv snorkende hoder som prinsessene må klø dagen lang, helt til han blir til tåke, ett hode om gangen.
characters.look: A huge, hulking troll about three times as tall as a man, with rust-red, warty skin, a broad, sagging barrel of a body, very long arms that hang down to the floor and short bowed legs. On top of his thick neck sits a bunch of exactly twelve small heads, packed tightly together like a bunch of turnips, each with a knobbly nose, droopy ears and a wispy tuft of pale straw-coloured hair. He wears a moth-eaten dark-blue velvet cloak with a tattered fur collar.

characters.name: Trollprinsen
characters.description: Et stort, rart og ganske greit troll som gir kongssønnen sverdet og flasken, og som blir konge når trollkongen er borte.
characters.look: A huge, strange troll about three times as tall as a man, shaped like a giant sack of flour, with sloping shoulders, a small head, a big soft belly, short legs and huge webbed feet like a duck's. His skin is a weathered, ruddy tan. He has a nose as long as a cucumber, small kind amber eyes, big ears like cabbage leaves and a stiff crest of dark-brown hair standing straight up like a brush. He wears a mulberry-purple velvet tunic with a wide gold belt.

characters.name: Trollprinsens datter
characters.description: Trollprinsens datter. Først er hun en liten hund som bjeffer på en øy, så blir hun til en prinsesse med langt, lyst hår og et tynt slør som svever rundt henne.
characters.look: A willowy young woman of about eighteen with pale, milky skin, a long, narrow face, a tiny pointed nose, big silvery-grey eyes and long, pale-blonde hair that floats and drifts around her as if she were under water. A thin, misty veil floats around her too, as if lifted by a breeze. She wears a long, flowing apricot-coloured dress with a silver belt and goes barefoot.

characters.name: Kongen
characters.description: Kongen som har tolv døtre og er så glad i dem at han vil ha dem hos seg hele tiden.
characters.look: A small, wiry, elderly king with a narrow, kind, crinkly face, a small sharp nose, twinkling blue eyes, wisps of silver hair poking out under his crown and a long silver-grey beard braided into two plaits tied with little gold rings. He wears a low, wide gold crown set with green stones, a long turquoise robe with a collar of spotted grey sealskin and silver clasps shaped like fish, and soft grey felt slippers.

characters.name: Den nysgjerrige konen
characters.description: Den mest nysgjerrige konen i hele landet. Hun spør og spør, og løper rett til venninnene sine med nyheten.
characters.look: A short, bustling old woman with a plump little body on thin legs, like a robin, and a long neck that she cranes forward to see everything. She has a sharp little chin, a beaky nose, big curious eyes magnified by thick, round bottle-bottom spectacles and wispy white hair scraped into a tiny topknot like an onion. She wears a faded lavender dress, an orange knitted shawl and a patched brown apron with a deep pocket.

places.name: the Ship
places.look: A big, round-bellied old wooden sailing ship, its hull painted dark blue with a broad red stripe along the side, one tall mast with a single broad, square cream-coloured sail, a high carved stern with a big wooden tiller, a low rail around the deck, coils of rope and wooden barrels on deck, and a small wooden rowing boat hanging at its side.

places.name: the Pillar Hall
places.look: A tall, echoing hall inside a castle on a small rocky island, with rows of tall, smooth pale-stone columns, warm golden light from hanging oil lamps, a polished stone floor with a round star-shaped mosaic in the middle, tall arched windows looking out to sea, and a long carved wooden bench against one wall.

places.name: the Great Hall
places.look: The great hall of the king's farm by the sea: a long, high log hall with a steep, dark-beamed roof, walls hung with red and blue woven tapestries, small-paned windows looking out over the sea, a long carved table with benches, a big stone fireplace, and at the far end, on a low platform, the king's tall carved wooden chair and a long cushioned bench.
